system.description:
The Hermetic art deepens, letting the thaumaturge take a substance apart at its very seams and break compounds down into the elements that compose them.

Scinde performs complex changes to form, such as splitting water into breathable oxygen and loose hydrogen or reducing a compound into its separate elements. You must know every element involved (at least two levels of Science or Science: Chemistry) and work in a controlled laboratory setting. The working takes one hour per level of Alchemy and ends in a Static Mental Challenge set by the Storyteller. Retest with Science.
